race.description: Queanbeyan Cup 27 Nov Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ENTIRELY OAK (11) wasn't beaten far when racing over 1000m here last time out, ending up 0.5L off the winner. That figure stacks up in this race and while he is a long-time maiden, he's knocking on the door. EDIKA (7) resumes from a long break, yet his final run before the spell was a fourth in CL1 company at this venue after early interference, which gives him a genuine Mdn reference point. FRED ASTERN (8) gets the winkers on now and e can put his best foot forward. SPY TRADER (2) resumed with a sound effort at Albury after showing good promise at the end of last campaign. Better for the run there and with natural improvement, he can be right in the finish.
